protocol.purpose: Repair observed structured command-record loss failures with existing controls; exposed development on AIT/Casino and conditional family-held-out CAM-LDS interval-state check.

experiments.E1: Reproduce semantic-event, entity-context and random-dropout controls on unchanged splits
experiments.E2: Compare type-dropout and mixed-dropout against random-dropout under frozen record-loss conditions
experiments.E3: Secondary visible-record-state router with unique-event support gates and mixed-model fallback
experiments.E4: Conditional family-held-out CAM-LDS T1105 interval-state recognition with frozen method

ait.role: Previously exposed eight-run development data; regrouped audit-event task

casino.role: Previously exposed RAID2025 development source; unchanged v1 cohort and annotation-onset proxy
casino.prediction_unit: First observed audit event per source process-technique annotation and host; deduplicate event IDs and union overlapping labels. Other events can provide prior context but are not eligible training/scoring targets. This annotation-onset proxy is not independently established malicious-action onset.

cohort.selection: All author-annotated instances, SHA256(casino-robustness-v1:instance) sorted order
cohort.reason: The initial24-instance feasibility sample had no T1068 and one T1548 test annotation. Expanded before any Casino model fit or outcome inspection, using all available annotated instances rather than selecting favorable cases.
cohort.support_note: These are annotation inventory counts, not final deduplicated event targets or independent attacks.

camlds.role: External family-held-out author manifestation-window membership proxy; not direct confirmation of dangerous-step recognition
camlds.split_rule: Sort positive-bearing family IDs1,2,3,4,6 by SHA256(camlds-robustness-v2:+ID); first2 fit,next development,next calibration,last test; remaining families context reserve
camlds.prediction_unit: First observed audit event per host per fixed10-second UTC bin chosen without labels; supervise only events within author-designated technique manifestation windows; all underlying events retained as causal context. Query may be idle or on an unrelated host.
camlds.qualification: Both target and other-technique labels required in fit/calibration/test; report actual overlap/support and temporal-label limitations

history.entity_keys: Only keys explicitly present in currently visible target and prior fragments; run and host scoped. No label inputs.

protocol.metadata_features: Only observed record counts, record types, context count and context age; no true deletion mask or attacker identifiers

dropout_training.sample_weight_per_view: 1 divided by number of views, preserving total clean training weight and effective regularization
dropout_training.empty_view_prediction: forced no alarm in every arm
dropout_training.views_by_arm: Use arms[name].views; keep1/number_of_views sample weight per row; single-view arms unweighted

protocol.perturbation_scope: Random removal applies consistently to current and prior record fragments. Support burst removes only preceding 60 seconds at each target query, a targeted stress test rather than a shared physical outage. Channel removal is audit record-type removal, not a whole sensor outage.
protocol.decision_time: Target event timestamp plus common deadline. Only fragments whose simulated availability <= deadline and source timestamp <= target event time; no later source events. Native fragment arrival times are not measured.
protocol.delay_interpretation: At deadline >= injected deterministic delay, the clean view is restored by construction. Recovery is a buffering/replay control with a latency cost, not evidence of a learned robustness improvement.
protocol.empty_targets: Retain target in denominators, score 0, force no alarm, report observed-target coverage. Offline source-event roster is evaluator knowledge, not a deployable event trigger.

calibration.source: Clean calibration only, separately for each model and target; frozen across perturbations
calibration.interpretation: Other-label event flag rate, not verified benign false alarms or a population bound

protocol.target_support: Require both classes in fit, calibration and test; otherwise report unsupported without training target. Counts are correlated events, not independent attacks.
protocol.success_interpretation: Report paired per-run changes and actual flag burden at each common deadline. Three removal seeds characterize perturbation variability only. No significance claim from row resampling; no cherry-picked seed or target; absence of improvement closes the tested control, not all context methods.
protocol.novelty: Type dropout, mixtures of experts and observed-input routing are existing methods. This is a feasibility/control experiment; no novel algorithm or APT detection claim is established.

router.state: Current visible EXECVE bit plus2 times current visible PROCTITLE bit; metadata indices2 and3 after two text blocks
router.support_count: Unique underlying fit event IDs with observed evidence, never augmented row count
router.empty_rows: Exclude fully unobserved views from specialists; retain1/6 weights for remaining rows
router.fallback: Already-fitted mixed_dropout single model for insufficient route support
router.capacity_note: Up to4 additional logistic regressions; secondary descriptive control, not equal parameter budget
router.forbidden: True deletion mask, condition names, hidden full-event channels, history channel state, future events

primary_comparison.interpretation: All five descriptive gates required; no significance/population noninferiority guarantee. Secondary arms remain secondary irrespective of results.

protocol.freeze: No target/condition/arm/threshold/gate changes after fit. AIT/Casino exposed development; CAM method frozen before CAM outcomes. Preserve negative results and baseline reproduction checks.

source_qualification_amendment.reason: Pre-fit source inspection found author windows are padded and manually adjusted around attacker command execution; labels indicate manifestation-window membership, not literal active execution or individual-event maliciousness. No source method, split, model, parameter, perturbation, threshold or success gate changed.
source_qualification_amendment.source_window_rule: Author start <= timestamp < end; typical padding start command timestamp minus2seconds/end output completion plus4seconds, with manual adjustments and sleep extensions. Local union rule for any overlapping windows must be disclosed and counted.
source_qualification_amendment.confirmation_limit: Separate-source exploratory proxy, not confirmation of Casino onset target or full APT detection.

pre_fit_mask_repair.finding: Independent pre-fit input scan found eight used-text fragments containing fixed testbed host variable LINUXSHARE; no CAM model had been fitted or scored.
pre_fit_mask_repair.repair: Extend the CAM-only fixed public host-name mask to LINUXSHARE, corpdns and reposerver. Stream-remask only text/baseline_text; verify all labels, target/query rosters, timestamps, entity links, record types and split assignments remain unchanged.
pre_fit_mask_repair.preservation: Original CAM prepared stream/cache and prior protocols preserved. Use a new bound stream and feature cache for the first CAM fit. AIT/Casino data and results unchanged.
pre_fit_mask_repair.scientific_controls: All arms, model parameters, fit views, source families, stress conditions, seeds, calibration procedure and primary gates are unchanged.
pre_fit_mask_repair.interpretation: Pre-fit source masking correction, not tuning on model outcomes; general command semantics remain inputs and residual template dependence is not excluded.
